Introduction

Chenle is a Chinese singer under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT Dream and NCT U. He made his official debut on August 24, 2016, with NCT Dream's digital single "Chewing Gum".

Before debuting in NCT, Chenle was a successful child singer in China. He released 3 albums: "Tomorrow" (2010), "My Wing" (2011), and the concert album "Music With You" (2014). Over 10 years later, Chenle released his first solo EP, Lucid, in China on May 5, 2025.
